name: viewer
_comment: Registers the FW Lite viewer as an nx project for affected detection only. The viewer lives in the frontend/ pnpm workspace, which nx cannot see from the repo root, hence this file. pnpm scripts stay the way to build and test it; the one target below is never run.

metadata.description: Never run. Its `default` input (which includes nx.json's sharedGlobals) makes a shared-file change mark this project affected; the frontend/tests files are imported by the viewer's Playwright tests.
